cards.front: No soy capaz de darle la noticia.
cards.back: I can't bring myself to break the news to her.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no te puedes armar de valor para darle la noticia?
cards.back: Why can't you bring yourself to break the news to her?

cards.front: No soy capaz de darle la noticia porque no paro de pensar en cómo reaccionará.
cards.back: I can't bring myself to break the news to her because I keep on thinking how she'll react.

cards.front: No me podía armar de valor para despedirla.
cards.back: I couldn't bring myself to let her go.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no fuiste capaz de despedirla?
cards.back: Why couldn't you bring yourself to let her go?

cards.front: No me pude armar de valor para despedirla porque no paraba de pensar en qué les pasaría a sus hijos.
cards.back: I couldn't bring myself to let her go because I kept on thinking of what would happen to her children.

cards.front: No fui capaz de cortarle la cabeza a la gallina.
cards.back: I couldn't bring myself to cut the chicken's head off.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no pudiste cortarle la cabeza a la gallina?
cards.back: Why couldn't you bring yourself to cut the chicken's head off?

cards.front: No pude armarme de valor para cortarle la cabeza a la gallina porque no dejaba de pensar en cuánto le dolería.
cards.back: I couldn't bring myself to cut the chicken's head off because I kept on thinking how much it would hurt.

cards.front: Ella no fue capaz de quitarse la tirita.
cards.back: She couldn't bring herself to pull her plaster off.

cards.back: Why couldn't she bring herself to pull her plaster off?

cards.front: No fue capaz de quitarse la tirita porque no dejaba de pensar en cuánto le dolería.
cards.back: She couldn't bring herself to pull her plaster off because she kept on thinking how much it would hurt.

cards.front: Fred no fue capaz de disculparse ante ella.
cards.back: Fred couldn't bring himself to say sorry to her.

cards.front: ¿Por qué él no fue capaz de disculparse ante ella?
cards.back: Why couldn't he bring himself to say sorry to her?

cards.front: No pudo disculparse ante ella porque no dejaba de pensar en cómo reaccionaría.
cards.back: He couldn't bring himself to say sorry to her because he kept on thinking how she would react.

cards.front: La revolución industrial provocó cambios en la sociedad a gran escala.
cards.back: The industrial revolution brought about large-scale change in society.

cards.front: Los movimientos de derechos civiles del siglo XX provocaron cambios a gran escala en la sociedad.
cards.back: The civil rights movements in the 20th century brought about large-scale change in society.

cards.front: Se podría sostener que nada ha provocado tanto cambio a gran escala en la sociedad como el desarrollo de la agricultura.
cards.back: It could be argued that nothing has brought about as much large-scale change in society as the development of agriculture.

cards.front: El nacimiento del hijo de Jack le ha provocado un cambio en su perspectiva vital que echaba mucho en falta.
cards.back: The birth of Jack's son has brought about a much-needed change in his outlook on life.

cards.front: Todas estas nuevas responsabilidades han provocado un cambio muy necesario en el comportamiento de Tom.
cards.back: All these new responsibilities have brought about a much-needed change in Tom's behaviour.

cards.front: Los acontecimientos recientes han provocado un cambio muy necesario en la actitud de Rhys acerca de su trabajo.
cards.back: Recent events have brought about a much-needed change in Rhys' attitude towards his work.

cards.front: La última ronda de recortes ha provocado una reacción fuerte por parte de la población.
cards.back: The latest round of cuts has brought about a strong reaction on the part of the general population.

cards.front: La visita del presidente provocó reacciones inesperadas por parte de los ciudadanos.
cards.back: The president's visit brought about some unexpected reactions on the part of the citizens.

cards.front: La extraña reacción por parte de los aficionados ante el nuevo fichaje preocupa a la dirección del equipo.
cards.back: The strange reaction on the part of the fans brought about by the new signing is troubling the team's management.

cards.front: La introducción de una hora de descuentos ha provocado un aumento en el número de clientes los jueves por la tarde.
cards.back: The introduction of a happy hour has brought about a rise in the number of punters on Thursday evenings.

cards.front: Una disminución en la demanda ha provocado un descenso en la producción.
cards.back: Decreased demand has brought about a drop in output.

cards.front: Las temperaturas inusualmente bajas han provocado un descenso del volumen de ventas de helado, pero un aumento de ventas de bufandas.
cards.back: The unusually low temperatures have brought about a drop in the volume of ice cream sales but a rise in scarf sales.

cards.front: Un extraño giro de los acontecimientos provocó finalmente la ruina de la empresa.
cards.back: A strange turn of events eventually brought about the downfall of the company.

cards.front: Al final, su propia arrogancia lo llevó a la ruina.
cards.back: His downfall was eventually brought about by his own arrogance.

cards.front: Las epidemias, los problemas económicos y las pérdidas de las cosechas acabaron por provocar la caída de la dinastía Ming.
cards.back: Health epidemics, economic problems and crop failures eventually brought about the downfall of the Ming Dynasty.

cards.front: Al final, todas esas bromas le hicieron sonreír. (joking)
cards.back: All that joking around eventually brought a smile to his face.

cards.front: Al final, todas esas bromas le hicieron sonreír. (kidding)
cards.back: All that kidding around eventually brought a smile to his face.

cards.front: Al final, todas esas tonterías le hicieron sonreír.
cards.back: All that clowning around eventually brought a smile to his face.

cards.front: Al final, todos esos chistes comunes le hicieron sonreír abiertamente.
cards.back: All those running jokes eventually brought a grin to his face.

cards.front: Al final, todo ese toma y daca le hizo sonreír abiertamente.
cards.back: All that back and forth eventually brought a grin to his face.

cards.front: Al final, todo ese bromear le hizo sonreír abiertamente.
cards.back: All that banter eventually brought a grin to his face.

cards.front: La idea de vengarse le provocó una sonrisa picarona.
cards.back: The idea of getting his own back brought a smirk to his face.

cards.front: La idea de ponerles en evidencia ante sus amigos le provocó una sonrisa picarona.
cards.back: The idea of showing them up in front of their friends brought a smirk to his face.

cards.front: La idea de hacer probar su propia medicina a esos idiotas le provocó una sonrisa picarona.
cards.back: The thought of giving those fools a taste of their own medicine brought a smirk to his face.

cards.front: Al final, todos esos chistes verdes le hicieron enrojecer.
cards.back: All those rude jokes eventually brought a blush to his cheeks.

cards.front: Al final, todos esos chistes guarros le hicieron enrojecer.
cards.back: All those dirty jokes eventually brought a blush to his cheeks.

cards.front: Al final, todo ese lenguaje obsceno le hizo enrojecer.
cards.back: All that foul language eventually brought a blush to his cheeks.

cards.front: Al final, tanto rememorar le hizo llorar.
cards.back: All that reminiscing eventually brought a tear to his eyes.

cards.front: Al final, pensar en todas esas noches geniales de fiesta le hizo llorar.
cards.back: The thought of all those awesome nights out on the town eventually brought a tear to his eyes.

cards.front: Al final, recordar todas las maldades que solían hacer le hizo llorar profundamente.
cards.back: Looking back on all the mischief they used to get up to eventually brought tears to his eyes.

cards.front: Es imprescindible que el gobierno haga bajar la tasa de desempleo.
cards.back: It's essential that the government bring down unemployment figures.

cards.front: Los funcionarios de salud tienen que tomar medidas para hacer bajar la tasa de infección en los hospitales públicos.
cards.back: Health officials need to take action in order to bring down infection rates in public hospitals.

cards.front: Si los supermercados no bajan el precio de los alimentos básicos, a la gente le costará cada vez más dar de comer a sus familias.
cards.back: If supermarkets don't bring down the price of staple foods, people will find it harder and harder to feed their families.

cards.front: Cientos de miles de manifestantes tomaron las calles con el fin de derrocar al gobierno.
cards.back: Hundreds of thousands of protestors took to the streets with the aim of bringing down the government.

cards.front: Los manifestantes en Serbia tomaron las calles para derrocar al dictador Slobodan Milosevic en octubre de 2000.
cards.back: Protestors in Serbia took to the streets to bring down the dictator Slobodan Milosevic in October 2000.

cards.front: Tomar las calles y protestar es una forma pacífica de intentar derrocar regímenes brutales.
cards.back: Taking to the streets and protesting is a non-violent way to try and bring down brutal regimes.

cards.front: Y una vez más, el equipo local derriba a otro jugador tras un duro placaje de rugby.
cards.back: And yet again the home team brings down another player after a rough rugby tackle.

cards.front: Y una vez más el equipo visitante derriba a otro jugador estrella con una falta muy fea.
cards.back: And yet again, the away team brings down another star player with a nasty foul.

cards.front: Y una vez más, el equipo local derriba a un jugador estrella de baloncesto de forma táctica.
cards.back: And yet again, the home team brings down a star basketball player using pure tactics.

cards.front: Menos mal que el caza fue derribado en medio de la nada.
cards.back: It's a good thing that the fighter plane was brought down in the middle of nowhere.

cards.front: El helicóptero volaba fuera del radar en medio de la nada cuando fue derribado.
cards.back: The helicopter was flying off the radar in the middle of nowhere when it was brought down.

cards.front: El avión de pasajeros fue derribado por terroristas en medio de la nada.
cards.back: The passenger plane was brought down by terrorists in the middle of nowhere.

cards.front: Si derribas la puerta, ¡se te acusará de allanamiento!
cards.back: If you knock down the door, you'll be charged with breaking and entering!

cards.front: Se le acusó a él de allanamiento después de que le pillaran derribando la puerta.
cards.back: He was charged with breaking and entering after he was caught knocking down the door.

cards.front: Alguien debe de haber derribado la puerta. Hay señales claras de allanamiento.
cards.back: Someone must have knocked the door down. There are clear signs of breaking and entering.

cards.front: Si yo fuera tú, esperaría a que sacaran la versión 2.0 de ese software para instalarlo.
cards.back: If I were you, I'd wait until they brought out version 2.0 of that software to install it.

cards.front: A la hora de comprar un coche, siempre es más barato comprar el modelo del año anterior que el que acaban de sacar.
cards.back: When shopping for cars, it's always cheaper to buy the previous year's model than the one they've just brought out.

cards.front: ¿Te has enterado de que van a sacar algo llamado Agua Seca? ¡No es más que aire embotellado!
cards.back: Have you heard they're bringing out something called Dry Water? It's nothing but bottled air!

cards.front: John Crisham va a sacar una nueva novela de suspense este otoño. ¡Qué ganas tengo de leerla!
cards.back: John Crisham is bringing out a new thriller this fall. I can't wait!

cards.front: Voy a sacar un álbum con Virgo Records esta primavera. ¡Estate al loro!
cards.back: I'm bringing out an album with Virgo Records this spring. Watch out for it!

cards.front: Mi tía soltera va a sacar una guía matrimonial. Qué irónico, ¿no?
cards.back: My unmarried aunt is bringing out a marriage guidance book. How ironic, right?!

cards.front: ¡Cuando se trata de chocolate no me puedo resistir ni aunque me salgan granos!
cards.back: I can't help myself when it comes to chocolate even though it brings me out in spots!

cards.front: John ha estado enamorado en secreto de Julia durante años, pero la sola idea de hablar con ella le da sudores fríos.
cards.back: John has been secretly in love with Julia for years but the very thought of talking to her brings him out in a cold sweat.

cards.front: ¡Estoy seguro de que había marisco en esa sopa! Me provocó un sarpullido terrible.
cards.back: I'm sure there was seafood in that soup! It brought me out in a terrible rash.

cards.front: Soy tan insolente e infantil cuando está él... ¡Es como si sacara lo peor de mí!
cards.back: I'm so snippy and childish around him. He just seems to bring out the worst in me!

cards.front: Según como lo mires, la presión saca lo peor o lo mejor de la gente.
cards.back: Depending on how you look at it, pressure brings out either the worst or the best in people.

cards.front: El debate sacó lo peor de los diputados.
cards.back: The debate brought out the worst in the members of congress.

cards.front: ¡El voluntariado realmente saca lo mejor que tienes dentro!
cards.back: Volunteer work really seems to bring out the best in you!

cards.front: Me caso con él porque saca lo mejor que hay en mí. Me gusto más a mí misma cuando estoy con él.
cards.back: I'm marrying him because he brings out the best in me. I like myself more when I'm around him.

cards.front: El judo saca de dentro lo mejor que tienen los niños hiperactivos. Les ayuda a controlar su agresividad.
cards.back: Judo brings out the best in hyperactive children. It helps them control their aggression.

cards.front: Nuevas oportunidades han provocado un cambio considerable en las perspectivas que tiene esta generación en la vida.
cards.back: New opportunities have brought forth a considerable change in this generation's outlook on life.

cards.front: El director del colegio pidió a la clase que se graduaba que provocara el cambio que deseaba ver en el mundo y en sí mismos.
cards.back: The headmaster called upon the graduating class to bring forth the change they wished to see in the world and in themselves.

cards.front: Las declaraciones del ministro provocaron muchísimas críticas.
cards.back: The minister's statement brought forth a lot of criticism.

cards.front: La conferencia no puede esperar tanto. Vamos a tener que adelantarla.
cards.back: The conference can't wait that long. We're going to have to bring it forward.

cards.front: La boda se adelantó de fecha por la mala salud de mi abuelita.
cards.back: The wedding was brought forward due to my granny's poor health.

cards.front: Quisiera adelantar la fecha de salida y dejar la vuelta tal cual, por favor.
cards.back: I'd like to bring forward the departure date and leave the return as it is, please.

cards.front: ¿A qué se debe eso?
cards.back: What brought that on?

cards.front: No sé a qué se debe eso.
cards.back: I don't know what brought that on.

cards.front: ¿Sabes a qué se debe eso?
cards.back: Do you know what brought that on?

cards.front: ¡Nadie te ha dicho que fueras irrespetuoso con tu jefa! Si te ha despedido, ¡tú te lo has buscado!
cards.back: Nobody told you to be disrespectful to your boss! If she fired you, you brought it on yourself!

cards.front: Me temo que nos hemos buscado este problema nosotros mismos al no estar atentos a las señales de advertencia.
cards.back: I'm afraid we've brought this problem on ourselves by not being on the lookout for warning signs.

cards.front: Todo el mundo cree que él está siendo injusto con ella, pero lo cierto es que ella se lo ha buscado.
cards.back: Everyone thinks he's being unfair to her, but the truth is she brought it on herself.

cards.front: Entrenador, ¿por qué no sacas a Jack? ¡Es de lejos el mejor jugador del equipo!
cards.back: Coach, why won't you bring on Jack? He's the best player on the team by far!

cards.front: Sacaron a Sarah de delantera después de que Jenny se lesionara.
cards.back: Sarah was brought on as forward after Jenny injured herself.

cards.front: Entrenador, ¿no crees que ya es hora de que me saques a jugar?
cards.back: Coach, don't you think it's time you brought me on to play?
